When should an association move from Mailchimp to HubSpot?

Can HubSpot connect to our AMS?

Yes. The Ricochet AMS Connector moves member data between your AMS and HubSpot.

Start with clean, connected member data, then automate the journeys that matter most, such as welcome, renewal and event promotion. How do associations connect marketing to sales?

Put both on one system. In HubSpot, marketing and sales work from the same member and company records, so a lead who engages with a campaign moves into a sales pipeline for membership, sponsorship or exhibit space. Workflows route leads to reps, and reports show leadership the results. Ricochet sets up Sales Hub in 12 weeks.

Questions

What associations ask about HubSpot implementation

How long does a HubSpot implementation take?

Sixteen weeks for Marketing Hub and twelve for Sales Hub. Smaller scopes can launch faster, and we recommend a timeline after we review your goals.

How much of our staff's time does it take?

Plan on 30 to 50 hours of staff time for Marketing Hub and 20 to 30 hours for Sales Hub, spread across the project.

Do we need HubSpot before we start?

You need an active HubSpot subscription before implementation begins. If you are still choosing, we help you pick and license the right Hubs.

Can we implement one Hub or several?

Either. Marketing Hub, Sales Hub and Service Hub can launch alone or together.

Will you migrate our emails, forms and workflows?

No. We guide what to bring over and train your team to rebuild or import it on a schedule that fits.

We already use HubSpot. Can you help?

Yes. We audit and refresh your setup, then expand automation and AMS syncing.

How should we prepare before buying HubSpot?

Plan before you sign. Line up the purchase with your budget cycle and capital approval, check your current email platform contract for its end date and notice window, and plan at least four weeks with both platforms running. Ricochet helps you prepare the whole move at no cost, before you sign anything with HubSpot or with us.

Is the HubSpot license negotiable?

Yes, when you go in with a plan. Buying the right Hubs, tier and contact count matters as much as the price. Ricochet's experts negotiate these purchases for associations and help you apply for the nonprofit discount. For the implementation discount on Ricochet's services, Ricochet must make the first contact with HubSpot.
